name: amazing-hashbrown
description: Local LLM agent harness: a persona knowledge base and autonomous assistant.

scripts.test: npm run test --workspace lib/inference-adapter && npm run test --workspace lib/llm-wiki && npm run test --workspace lib/rlm && npm run test --workspace lib/tools-manager && npm run test --workspace api && npm run test --workspace ui
